headline: Tencent's hy4-flash seizes No. 1 with 39.1% of tokens, and Tencent leads providers at 41.2%
summary: Tencent's hy4-flash-20261116 debuted at the top of the leaderboard with 39.1% of tokens, a first-time rank 1 that clears the all-time share record. Tencent as a provider now sits at 41.2%, and it has gained 31.9% in share over the past day, which is the kind of number that makes the rest of the table look nervous.
highlights: Tencent's hy4-flash-20261116 is the day's first-time No. 1, holding 39.1% of tokens after climbing three spots.
Tencent leads provider share at 41.2%, and Tencent plus DeepSeek together account for 65.6% of tokens.
DeepSeek's deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 slips to No. 2 with 17.6% of tokens, a drop of one place.
Three new entrants arrived: thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small-20261107 at No. 32, google/gemini-4-hydrogen-20261112 at No. 50, and openai/gpt-oss-120b at No. 51.
particle-ai/particle-1-20261027:free leapt 13 spots to No. 31, the biggest single-day climb on the board.
Dropping off the leaderboard are qwen/qwen4-max-20261115, minimax/minimax-m3-20260531, and openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903.
